Getting a Partial Denture

A 1-minute patient guide with narration. Press space to pause, F for full screen.

Patient guide

Getting a partial denture.

Here is what to expect, start to finish.

Filling the gap.

When several teeth are missing, a partial denture fills the space. It clips onto your natural teeth and comes out for cleaning.

Why fill it?

Gaps make chewing harder, and over time nearby teeth can drift or tilt into the open space.

A precise fit.

We take impressions or a digital scan so your partial is made to fit your mouth.

Made just for you.

Natural-looking teeth on a gum-colored base, with small clasps that hold it in place.

Clicks into place.

Small metal clasps hug your natural teeth near the gum line to keep the partial steady while you eat and talk.

Give it a few weeks.

It may feel a little bulky at first. Most people get used to it within a few weeks.

Easy to care for.

Take it out and clean it every day, and keep brushing your natural teeth too.

Brush it dailyTake it out at nightKeep your checkups

Questions? Just ask.

Your dental team is happy to walk you through every step before, during, and after your visit.
